_about: John Henry Parker (1806-1884), Oxford publisher and antiquary, Keeper of the Ashmolean, raw IA OCR of his Archaeology of Rome (the text volumes; the plates volume of part I is left out) and a pamphlet on Roman building methods (1868). His Gothic architecture books are outside lane B. Roman antiquities (lane B, round dz: sixth IA subject sweep). No uids minted.
